approved_scope.title: Change review refuses to pass a change finalize would refuse on ownership
approved_scope.description: change review refuses to pass a change finalize would refuse on ownership
approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: Invariant 51 says canonical ownership is checked before a human is asked to act; a passing review is that act and the Archive check names change ship for a change with a passing review at HEAD. Leif chose this fix (option b) on 2026-11-10
acceptance_criteria: change review with a passing verdict refuses a verifying change whose production delivery inputs no declared module owns, naming the blocker and the send-back and answer recovery, and records nothing; a blocking verdict is still recorded; so a passing review at HEAD implies ship would not refuse on ownership, and the Archive check's change ship advice holds without a SpecSync binary

answers.constraints: ownership is decided exactly as ship preflight and finalize decide it (ownership_preflight_blocker); archive_candidate_can_ship keeps its own ownership check for reviews recorded before this refusal
